item.title: FORD RECALLS 4.4 MILLION TRUCKS, VANS AND SUV’S
item.description: Ford Motor is recalling nearly 4.4 million vehicles over a software problem that could cause an attached trailer’s tail lights, turn signals, and brakes to fail.
